description_sq:

description_en: We have a 2+1+2 apartment for sale in the Dry Lake area. Property information: • Net area: 203 m² • Floor: 6 • Orientation: East – West • New construction, with elevator • Unobstructed view of the Lake Organization: • Spacious living and cooking area • 2 bedrooms • 2 bathrooms • Laundry • Wardrobe • Balcony Other settings: • Fully invested apartment • Functional fireplace • Modern furnishings carefully realized in every detail • Blue LED night lighting throughout the apartment • Toilets with chromotherapy system • Thermal and acoustic insulation throughout the apartment • Central underfloor heating system • Triplex windows • Quality parquet • Air conditioning system • Possibility of parking with extra price • Regular mortgage documentation For more information or for a visit to the property, please contact us.
